assets: native/Sources/NTSDMacPlatform/Resources/OriginalMusic: 8 CAF/ALAC tracks; manifest.json records per track the frame count and the SHA-256 of the 16-bit PCM (FFmpeg float decode of bgm/*.wma, saturate(roundHalfEven(x*32768))) that was ALAC-encoded losslessly

decoder.vendored: native/Sources/CALAC: Apple ALAC reference decoder, github.com/macosforge/alac c38887c5c5e64a4b31108733bd79ca9b2496d987 codec/, Apache-2.0, 13 files unchanged (upstream.json with original/vendored SHA-256), plus NTSDALAC.cpp (C interface)
decoder.swift: native/Sources/NTSDMusicDecoder/OriginalALACTrack.swift: CAF reader (desc, kuki, pakt variable-length packet sizes, data; priming/remainder trimming) and per-packet decode
decoder.byteOrder: vendor/EndianPortable.c defines TARGET_RT_LITTLE_ENDIAN only for x86/Win32 and Apple gets it from TargetConditionals.h; on Linux aarch64 the decoder skipped its byte swaps and rejected the first packet (first Linux run: corrupt("packet at 8192")). Package.swift now defines TARGET_RT_LITTLE_ENDIAN=1 for CALAC on non-Apple platforms; vendored files unchanged

player: NTSDSDL SDLMusicPlayer: OriginalMacMusicOutput.Player on its own SDL audio stream (S16 stereo 44.1 kHz, SDL converts), decoded in the background, duration from the packet table at once, end reported on the main thread like AVAudioPlayer; a failed decode is reported as an sdlMusicError event. Used by every NTSDSDL build (macOS too)
